Author: Glamour Pact contributors
Name: Glamour Pact
Punchline: Dom-controlled looks, local Synced Mods and opt-in strict controls.
Description: An opt-in Dom/Sub outfit library with named outfits, copyable macros, a Lock glams toggle, separate Sub editing permissions, local Synced Looks, Customize+ profile choices and helmet controls without weapon edits. Optional exact-Dom follow, looping pose locks and GPact Offline control; disabling the plugin remains the local exit. Both players need this update for library controls.
Changelog: Adds the shared Outfit Library with named outfits, chest icons, saved GPact mods, opt-in Customize+ profiles and exact-pact macro copy buttons. Dom Lock glams allows self-glam without going Offline; separate add/edit/delete permissions preserve Sub-owned outfit editing without bypassing wear locks. Adds temporary Dom preview, existing sync installation and verified outfit save, plus helmet/visor controls without weapon edits. Updates looping emote locks for the reviewed game build and adds follow-only release. Both players must update; native controls require supported hooks and plugin disable remains the local exit. No new server polling or mod-file uploads.
